page.overview:
Who is Ally of Justice Decisive Armor?

Ally of Justice Decisive Armor, known as Ally of Justice Decisive Arms, in the Japanese version, is a character version of the card, "Ally of Justice Decisive Armor".

It appears in the video game Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2010: Reverse of Arcadia, as a Single Duel opponent.

You can unlock this opponent during Story Mode (clear chapter 2).
